name: African Head Charge
hook: On-U Sound's debut act, built around a Ghanaian percussionist and Adrian Sherwood's mixing desk rather than a fixed lineup.

blurb.age7: African Head Charge was the first group to release music on Adrian Sherwood's label, mixing drumming with dub-style echo and effects.
blurb.age13: Formed around percussionist Bonjo Iyabinghi Noah and producer Adrian Sherwood, African Head Charge released On-U Sound's debut album, 'My Life in a Hole in the Ground', in 1981, layering African and Caribbean percussion under heavy dub production.
blurb.adult: African Head Charge is less a fixed band than a project name for whatever collaborators Sherwood assembled around Bonjo Iyabinghi Noah's percussion at a given session, which makes it a clean early demonstration of On-U Sound's whole working method: dub technique applied to a rotating cast rather than a stable lineup.

signatureTracks.title: My Life in a Hole in the Ground
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: On-U Sound's debut release, and the founding statement of the label's dub-plus-percussion approach.

signatureTracks.title: Off the Beaten Track
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: A later, denser record showing the project's dub production growing more layered across the decade.
